context.title: Served definitions and instructions
context.text: Harbor means the sensor project governed by the March 2024 supply agreement. Alder means Alder Instruments. Documents includes existing ESI and attachments. The default period is January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2025 unless a request states otherwise. Original numbering is retained, including the repeated 8 and omitted 9 and 15.

context.title: Supplied case context
context.text: Bayline Labs alleges June 2025 Harbor sensors failed the agreed inspection criteria. Alder disputes the failures and causation. The only transactions pleaded concern Harbor, a product first designed in 2024. No other product or earlier design is alleged to be relevant. No employee-health or compensation issue is pleaded. Litigation counsel's legal-advice communications are confidential; no waiver is reported. Counsel interview memoranda were prepared after this dispute arose. The cost and accessibility of the backup tapes, prior-production identifiers, and any duplication burden have not been established. No search, production or withholding decisions have been supplied.

context.title: Supplied governing-source packet and limits
context.text: Federal rules supply a relevance/proportionality framework, protection for qualifying privileged and trial-preparation material, and item-specific response requirements. Rule 34 requires specific reasons, the extent of a partial objection, and disclosure of withholding. The objection draft leaves actual response and withholding positions to counsel. This is a synthetic federal RFP exercise. No real district or judge is assigned, and no local-order or circuit-law verification is claimed.
